By triangle inequality,
\[
|PM|-|PF_2|\le |MF_2|=\sqrt{(6-3)^2+(4-0)^2}=5.
\]
Since \(|PF_1|+|PF_2|=10\),
\[
|PM|+|PF_1|=10+(|PM|-|PF_2|)\le 10+5=15.
\]
Equality occurs when \(P,F_2,M\) are collinear with \(F_2\) between \(P\) and \(M\), e.g. at \(P=(0,-4)\) on the ellipse.

\[
\boxed{15}
\]
